title: Topological sort with cycle detection
prompt: Implement topoSort(deps) in topo.js. deps maps each node name to an array of the names it depends on; a name that appears only as a dependency is a node too. Return every node once, each after all of its dependencies. When several nodes could come next, take them in alphabetical order. If there is a cycle, throw an Error whose message starts with 'cycle:' followed by the names of the nodes in one cycle; nodes outside every cycle must not be named. Do not change test.js.
